name: Miles
text: Miles is an occasional anglicization of Míl Espáine, the eponymous ancestor of the Milesians. The form shows up where English retellings reach the ancestral genealogy.

attributes.attribute: English dress of the Milesian ancestor's name

okr.objective: Documents Miles as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Miles renders Míl Espáine in English dress.
Míl is the ancestor the Milesians take their name from.
